instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: As someone who checks school budgets for the local government, I spread papers about managing devices and helping students learn across my desk. I have sticky notes. Do I see this as money spent to reduce device use or to help students learn more? My hand stops as I write my review notes. While this difference is unclear, I can't say which should come first. I'm afraid of cutting needed support from a small budget. I can't simply use findings from other countries as the answer for my area. I have to explain what information I use to choose how to spend this money.
